hero.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems & Scalable Architecture
hero.subheading: 7+ Years Building High-Performance Microservices & Cloud-Native Ecosystems

aboutBullets: 7+ years of expertise in Backend Development, specializing in Node.js and Distributed Systems.
Architected and scaled systems supporting 100k+ concurrent users with sub-100ms latency.
Deep expertise in Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), and Clean Architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong leadership in technical decision-making, mentoring, and system design for complex enterprise solutions.

projects.title: Chat Microservice - Real-Time Messaging Platform
projects.description: Engineered a horizontally-scalable chat system supporting 100k+ concurrent users with distributed state management.
keyFeatures: Real-time presence tracking and notifications via Redis Pub/Sub
Distributed load balancing across multiple instances with sticky sessions
GraphQL subscription APIs for real-time data synchronization
projects.impact: Enabled seamless real-time communication at scale for a global user base.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Need to support 100k+ concurrent users with low latency and global presence management while maintaining message ordering and consistency.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Decoupled messaging architecture using WebSocket for bi-directional communication, Redis Pub/Sub for cross-node presence broadcasting, and GraphQL subscriptions for schema-driven real-time updates.
decisions: Redis Pub/Sub for presence to handle cross-node communication
Horizontal scaling with Docker & ECS to manage traffic bursts
MongoDB for message persistence with TTL-based archiving
caseStudy.results: Achieved sub-100ms latency across geographic regions with 99.9% uptime and zero message loss during peak loads.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: The system uses a 'Fan-out' pattern for message distribution. Load balancers use consistent hashing to route users to the nearest node, while Redis acts as the central orchestrator for state synchronization across the cluster.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Slot Booking Platform
projects.description: Enterprise SaaS platform with strict multi-tenancy, data isolation, and distributed locking.
keyFeatures: Row-level security and per-client data segregation at the database layer
Optimistic concurrency control with versioning to prevent double-bookings
Dynamic slot allocation engine with time-zone aware scheduling
Razorpay payment integration with automated payouts and ledger reconciliation
projects.impact: Provided a reliable foundation for B2B clients to manage thousands of bookings daily across multiple regions.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Building a SaaS that requires strict data isolation between tenants while allowing a shared resource pool and preventing race conditions during high-volume booking periods.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Adopted a 'Shared Schema, Discriminator Column' approach for cost-efficiency with logical isolation via middleware. Implemented distributed locking using Redis for critical booking sections.
decisions: Logical isolation via tenant_id middleware for performance
Distributed locks for the booking transaction to prevent race conditions
Webhook-based payment reconciliation to ensure eventual consistency
caseStudy.results: Zero reported overbooking incidents in production over 2 years and sub-second tenant data access.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: The architecture follows a Layered (N-Tier) design with a dedicated 'Tenant Context' provider in the request pipeline, ensuring that every database query is automatically scoped to the current tenant.

projects.title: Transportation & Freight Booking Platform
projects.description: Mission-critical logistics platform with real-time IoT tracking, automated settlements, and complex role-based access control.
keyFeatures: Granular RBAC for Loaders, Truckers, and Fleet Managers
SIM-based GPS tracking via Traqo API integration
Automated payment settlement pipeline from booking to delivery
Comprehensive Admin dashboard for fleet monitoring and financial reconciliation
projects.impact: Digitized traditional freight operations, significantly reducing manual overhead and increasing transparency.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Modernizing a legacy logistics process with real-time tracking and secure financial settlements across multiple stakeholders with varying access levels.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Modular monolith architecture with a robust Event Bus for internal communication. Integrated IoT APIs for live vehicle status and implemented a custom state machine for booking lifecycles.
decisions: State Machine for booking status to prevent illegal transitions
Integration with SIM-based GPS for high reliability in remote areas
Delayed settlement logic to allow for dispute resolution
caseStudy.results: Reduced manual coordination time by 40% and improved payment reconciliation accuracy by 98%.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: The platform utilizes a 'State-Machine' pattern to manage the complex lifecycle of a freight booking. Each status transition triggers specific events (notifications, ledger entries) via an internal event emitter.
